frozen_entry_and_state.event: completed 1h close outside the prior 96 completed hours with the existing completed-hour volume sponsorship and selected symbol-side rules
frozen_entry_and_state.entry: fixed 500ms after completed decision, first strictly later observable 1m open
frozen_entry_and_state.promotion: original broken boundary becomes protected only after a later completed 1h close extends beyond the original signal close
frozen_entry_and_state.state_loss: first later completed 1h reacceptance inside the promoted frozen boundary
frozen_entry_and_state.funding: actual signed Bybit funding with the inherited causal adverse-funding reserve

chronology.official: 2024-01-01 through 2026-06-30 continuous path only after unchanged pre-2024 survival

selection_rule: among routes with positive 24bp total return, positive median trade and exact winner-deletion/rerouting above 1.0x in both 2022 half-years, maximize the minimum half-year log growth; deterministic tie break prefers the smaller R target
confirmation_rule: selected route must remain positive, positive-median and exact winner-deletion-positive in unchanged 2023 without material trade-density collapse
decision: if no route survives or official value remains structurally tiny, preserve protected-boundary only as Expansion and the prior +1.5R full-realization route only as weak Core
